It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

Block is building the next generation of commerce experiences for merchants and PSPs through Afterpay, Cash App Pay, Clearpay, and Cash App Afterpay. As part of Block’s Solutions Engineering team, you will be a senior technical leader driving complex partner and merchant integrations. You’ll work directly with business development, sales, and product teams to deeply understand customer needs, showcase our APIs and services, and solve challenging technical problems that accelerate adoption. We are looking for an engineer with sales acumen, a thoughtful product sense, and an entrepreneurial spirit.

This is a senior individual contributor role - ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of technology and commerce, has prior hands-on software engineering experience, and can represent Block’s technical vision to global merchants and partners while influencing product direction internally.

You Will

• Partner with Sales & Account Management to support Block merchants and partners integrating with our platform, and co-sell Cash App Pay and Afterpay.
• Design and deliver technical solutions, including building proof-of-concepts, custom reports, sample integrations, and troubleshooting complex issues.
• Act as a trusted technical advisor - translating business requirements into scalable integration approaches and advocating for best practices.
• Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to surface partner feedback and influence the roadmap.
• Create and deliver compelling demos, presentations, and technical deep dives for both executive and engineering stakeholders.
• Communicate product features, updates, and technical guidance clearly across internal and external audiences.

You Have

• 7+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles (partner engineering, solutions architecture, sales engineering, or similar), working with enterprise merchants or global partners.
• Deep hands-on technical expertise – comfortable building with APIs, debugging integrations, and guiding developers through complex implementations.
• Prior professional experience with full-stack development and proficiency in at least one programming language, with the ability to rapidly learn new tools and technologies.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical audiences and influence senior stakeholders.
• Proven success leading technical projects or initiatives end-to-end in globally distributed, multicultural teams.
• A strong understanding of payments, fintech, or commerce platforms.
• Experience presenting to technical and executive audiences in both structured and impromptu settings.
• A willingness to travel for onsite client meetings (10-20%).

Block takes a market-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. U.S. locations are categorized into one of four zones based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. The successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. To find a location's zone designation, please refer to this resource. If a location of interest is not listed, please speak with a recruiter for additional information.

Zone A: ($171,000 - $256,900)
Zone B: ($159,400 - $239,000)
Zone C: ($150,800 - $226,200)
Zone D: ($142,200 - $213,200)

Application Guidelines

Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.
